title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: CatWalk: Reaction Pathway Generation and Transition State Sampling via Score-based Diffusion Models
items.abstract_or_text: Computing transition states for heterogeneous catalyst surface reactions is computationally demanding due to the relatively high cost in precisely locating a saddle point using ab initio electronic structure calculations. In this work, we present a new generative score-based diffusion model—CatWalk—that predicts the initial structures for reaction pathways of heterogeneous catalysts with surface adsorbates. Given only the desired reaction type and reactant structure, CatWalk produces nine pathway structures by iteratively perturbing the coordinates of the previous output. CatWalk was trained on 731 nudged elastic band (NEB) calculations from the CatTSunami dataset, which contains diverse substrate elements with adsorbates undergoing three types of chemical reactions: desorption, dissociation, and atom transfer. The model can be directed to target one of these three reaction types during generation, and due to its stochastic nature can generate various products via multiple pathways from the same initial state. Optimizing CatWalkgenerated pathways using a pretrained foundation machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) with the nudged elastic band (NEB) method leads to several lower-energy pathways compared to what is obtained by the traditional linear interpolation initialization method for NEBs. Additionally, repeated intermediate structure generations using CatWalk enabled sampling of different pathways and final states which can lead to multiple saddle points with variation in energy by up to 0.2 eV. Overall, CatWalk provides a general and scalable framework for accelerating reaction-pathway discovery, enabling broader exploration of catalytic mechanisms at significantly reduced computational cost.
items.summary_zh: CatWalk 提出用于异相催化表面反应的评分扩散模型：仅以反应类型和反应物结构为条件，生成反应路径的初始构型，并与机器学习原子间势和 NEB 优化结合以搜索过渡态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把生成模型直接用于催化机理与鞍点搜索，在 CatTSunami 的731条 NEB 计算上显示出较传统线性插值更低能的路径，并可发现能量相差最高0.2 eV的多个鞍点。当前训练反应仅含脱附、解离和原子转移三类，跨反应类型与真实催化体系的泛化仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 由于使用从头算电子结构计算精确定位鞍点的成本相对较高，计算异相催化剂表面反应的过渡态在计算上要求很高。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新的生成式评分扩散模型——CatWalk——用于预测带有表面吸附物的异相催化剂反应路径的初始结构。给定所需反应类型和反应物结构，CatWalk 通过迭代扰动前一输出的坐标生成九个路径结构。CatWalk 在 CatTSunami 数据集的731项弹性带法（NEB）计算上训练；该数据集包含多样的基底元素及其吸附物，经历三类化学反应：脱附、解离和原子转移。该模型在生成时可被引导至这三种反应类型中的任一种；由于其随机性，它可从同一初始态经由多条路径生成多种产物。使用预训练的基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）和弹性带法（NEB）优化 CatWalk 生成的路径，相比传统的 NEB 线性插值初始化方法，可得到若干能量更低的路径。此外，重复生成中间结构使 CatWalk 能够采样不同的路径和终态，从而可能得到多个鞍点，其能量变化最高可达0.2 eV。总体而言，CatWalk 为加速反应路径发现提供了通用且可扩展的框架，使得以显著降低的计算成本更广泛地探索催化机制成为可能。
items.author_line: Teerachote Pakornchote, Nima Karimitari, Jacob Clary, Ravishankar Sundararaman, Graeme Henkelman, Christopher Sutton

items.title: Prioritizing peptides for targeted mass spectrometry experiments using deep learning
items.abstract_or_text: One critical step in any targeted mass spectrometry experiment is selecting, from each protein of interest, a small number of peptides that respond well in the mass spectrometer and can serve as reliable proxies for protein quantification. Existing methods select target peptides either by relying on prior empirical measurements, limiting their applicability to previously observed peptides, or using machine learning to predict peptide behavior from sequence alone. However, current machine learning tools suffer from various limitations, including using detectability as an indirect proxy for intensity, relying on small training sets, or ignoring the precursor charge state. In this study, we introduce Bromo, a transformer-based deep learning model that ranks peptide precursors from a given protein by their relative response, taking charge state into account. Trained on millions of annotated peptide pairs derived from large-scale, publicly available data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry data, Bromo consistently outperforms existing sequence-based methods across diverse, independent datasets. Furthermore, we show that fine-tuning Bromo on experiment-specific data can account for differences in sample preparation, sample matrix, and instrument platform, all of which influence which peptides serve as optimal targets. This adaptability makes Bromo a practical tool for selecting target peptides for selected reaction monitoring and parallel reaction monitoring assay development across a wide range of experimental conditions.
items.summary_zh: Bromo 是一个考虑前体电荷态的 Transformer 模型，可在每个目标蛋白内按相对质谱响应排序肽前体，用于靶向质谱实验的肽段选择。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型以数百万个来自公开 DIA 质谱数据的带注释肽对训练，并在多样化独立数据集上优于既有序列模型；实验特异微调也面向实际 SRM/PRM 开发。需留意其性能仍可能受样品制备、基质和仪器平台差异影响。
items.abstract_zh: 任何靶向质谱实验中的一个关键步骤，都是从每个目标蛋白中选择少量在质谱仪中响应良好、可作为蛋白定量可靠替代指标的肽。现有方法选择目标肽时，要么依赖先前的经验测量，从而将适用性限制于已经观测过的肽；要么使用机器学习，仅从序列预测肽的行为。然而，当前机器学习工具存在多种限制，包括将可检测性用作强度的间接替代指标、依赖小型训练集，或忽略前体电荷态。在本研究中，我们提出 Bromo，一种基于 Transformer 的深度学习模型；它在给定蛋白内按相对响应对肽前体进行排序，并将电荷态纳入考虑。Bromo 在由大规模公开数据非依赖采集质谱数据得到的数百万个带注释肽对上训练，在多样化的独立数据集上持续优于现有的基于序列的方法。此外，我们表明，在实验特异性数据上对 Bromo 进行微调，可以解释样品制备、样品基质和仪器平台的差异；这些因素都会影响哪些肽最适合作为靶标。这种适应性使 Bromo 成为在广泛实验条件下为选择反应监测和并行反应监测测定开发选择肽段的实用工具。
items.author_line: Sonthalia, S., Wen, B., Dasgupta, P., Hsu, C., MacCoss, M. J., Noble, W. S.

items.title: Accurate and efficient prediction of protein conformations with ProtMonomer
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning-based protein structure prediction methods that leverage evolutionary information from multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), exemplified by AlphaFold2, have achieved remarkable accuracy. However, existing methods still struggle to predict challenging proteins, particularly those with novel folds or limited evolutionary information, and to recover alternative conformational states. Here we show that structure prediction models trained under different MSA-depth distributions corresponding to different levels of evolutionary information exhibit complementary generalization behaviors, and that a model trained on a mixture of these distributions can combine their complementary generalization strengths. Building on this insight, we developed ProtMonomer, a deep learning framework trained on MSA-depth distributions representing a broad range of evolutionary information levels to improve structure prediction. Across benchmarks comprising CASP15 targets, non-redundant experimentally determined structures, orphan proteins, and short peptides, ProtMonomer performed comparably to or better than leading methods, including AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3, with particularly strong performance on challenging targets. For fold-switching proteins, ProtMonomer also recovered alternative conformational states more accurately than AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 across diverse homologous sequence sampling strategies. In addition to improving predictive accuracy, ProtMonomer substantially reduced inference cost through an efficient architecture, enabling high-throughput applications. Together, these findings provide insights into the generalization of evolution-informed structure prediction models and support ProtMonomer as an accurate and efficient framework for protein structure prediction.
items.summary_zh: ProtMonomer 通过在不同 MSA 深度分布上训练深度学习模型，兼顾不同进化信息条件下的互补泛化能力，以提升蛋白质构象预测并降低推理成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型在 CASP15、非冗余实验结构、孤儿蛋白和短肽基准上与 AlphaFold2、AlphaFold3 相当或更优，并更准确恢复折叠切换蛋白的替代构象。结果来自预印本，且摘要未给出各测试集的绝对误差与失败谱，仍应结合全文评估。
items.abstract_zh: 利用多序列比对（MSA）进化信息的深度学习蛋白质结构预测方法，以 AlphaFold2 为代表，已经实现了显著的准确性。然而，现有方法仍难以预测具有挑战性的蛋白，尤其是具有新颖折叠或有限进化信息的蛋白，也难以恢复替代构象状态。我们在此表明，在对应不同进化信息水平的不同 MSA 深度分布下训练的结构预测模型，表现出互补的泛化行为；而在这些分布混合上训练的模型能够结合其互补的泛化优势。基于这一认识，我们开发了 ProtMonomer：一个在代表广泛进化信息水平的 MSA 深度分布上训练的深度学习框架，用于改进结构预测。在由 CASP15 靶标、非冗余实验确定的结构、孤儿蛋白和短肽组成的基准中，ProtMonomer 的表现与包括 AlphaFold2 和 AlphaFold3 在内的领先方法相当或更好，尤其在挑战性靶标上表现强劲。对于折叠切换蛋白，在多种同源序列采样策略下，ProtMonomer 恢复替代构象状态的准确性也高于 AlphaFold2 和 AlphaFold3。除提升预测准确性外，ProtMonomer 还通过高效架构显著降低了推理成本，从而支持高通量应用。总之，这些发现揭示了进化信息驱动的结构预测模型的泛化能力，并支持 ProtMonomer 作为准确且高效的蛋白质结构预测框架。
items.author_line: Si, Y., Zhang, S., Chen, L.

items.title: Predicting CYP450 Induction and PXR Activation with Machine Learning Approaches: Challenges and Opportunities
items.abstract_or_text: Many drugs increase the activity of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, an effect known as induction, which is a major cause of harmful drug-drug interactions (DDIs). Predicting induction from chemical structure would help identify DDI risks early in compound development. Yet, unlike many other drug properties, CYP450 induction is rarely modeled, because the data needed to train models is scarce and expensive to produce. Using an industry-scale dataset covering induction of three CYP450 enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2B6, CYP1A2) and PXR activation, we benchmark four machine learning models across six molecular representations and compare performance against models trained on a curated public dataset. On the internal data, the best models separate inducers from non-inducers moderately well (MCC ~0.5) but cannot predict the magnitude of induction, and no model or representation does meaningfully better, pointing to the data rather than the method as the limit. The same pattern holds in public data, where a large public PXR set reaches this range, while a small, heterogeneous public CYP3A4 set fails where the data is scarcer and noisier. We then show that the shared biology of these endpoints carries a usable signal. A model trained on one endpoint partly predicts the others, and this transfer follows the known regulatory relationships between PXR and the CYP450 enzymes, so these biological links can serve as useful inductive biases for future models. Finally, we found that the models we trained are already reasonably well calibrated, which, combined with their classification performance, makes them useful for prioritizing compounds today.
items.summary_zh: 研究以工业规模数据集比较四类机器学习模型和六种分子表示，用于预测 CYP3A4、CYP2B6、CYP1A2 诱导及 PXR 激活，并检验端点间迁移能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: CYP450 诱导是药物相互作用的重要早期风险，本工作清楚显示数据质量和规模比模型选择更限制性能，并报告约0.5的最佳 MCC 和合理校准。模型尚不能预测诱导幅度，公开 CYP3A4 数据的异质性也限制了结论。
items.abstract_zh: 许多药物会提高细胞色素 P450（CYP450）酶的活性，这种效应称为诱导，是有害药物-药物相互作用（DDI）的主要原因。根据化学结构预测诱导，有助于在化合物开发早期识别 DDI 风险。然而，与许多其他药物性质不同，CYP450 诱导很少被建模，因为训练模型所需的数据稀缺且获取成本高。我们使用涵盖三种 CYP450 酶（CYP3A4、CYP2B6、CYP1A2）诱导和 PXR 激活的工业规模数据集，在六种分子表示上对四种机器学习模型进行基准测试，并将性能与在经整理的公共数据集上训练的模型进行比较。在内部数据上，最佳模型能以中等程度区分诱导剂和非诱导剂（MCC 约为0.5），但无法预测诱导幅度；没有任何模型或表示明显更好，表明限制因素是数据而非方法。公共数据中也呈现同样的模式：大型公开 PXR 数据集达到这一范围，而在数据更稀缺、噪声更大的小型异质性公开 CYP3A4 数据集上则失败。随后我们表明，这些端点的共同生物学具有可用信号。在一个端点上训练的模型可部分预测其他端点，而且这种迁移遵循 PXR 与 CYP450 酶之间已知的调控关系，因此这些生物学联系可作为未来模型有用的归纳偏置。最后，我们发现所训练模型已具有相当合理的校准度；结合其分类性能，它们如今可用于化合物优先排序。
items.author_line: Markus Orsi, Anton Thieme, Matteo Gätzner, Nicolò Milani, Joe Napoli, Michael Reutlinger, Kenichi Umehara, Johannes Kirchmair, Andrea Andrews-Morger, Jamie Clifton

items.title: Quantifying Multi-Objective Optimization in Generative Chemistry for Molecule Design
items.abstract_or_text: Multi objective optimization (MOO) is central to molecular design, yet its impact on generative chemistry outcomes remains poorly quantified. Consequently, it is unclear how different MOO strategies influence chemical space exploration and property optimization in generative methods. Here, we introduce a benchmarking framework for evaluating MOO strategies in generative chemistry. Six MOO approaches are highlighted including arithmetic and geometric means, non dominated sorting, Chebyshev scalarization, generational distance, and binary thresholding within a lead optimization setting. Across 60 scaffolds derived from six potency datasets, we explore a many-objective task for the simultaneous optimization of various compound properties, including potency, solubility and lipophilicity. We evaluate methods using metrics aligned to recurring medicinal chemistry use cases or decision scenarios and assess differences across datasets and scaffolds. We find that the MOO choice substantially changes both optimization outcomes and explored chemical space across datasets, scaffold and intended use cases. Overall, our results provide practical, use case driven guidance for selecting and comparing MOO strategies in generative chemistry workflows.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出生成化学中多目标优化的基准框架，在六个效力数据集衍生的60个骨架上比较六种策略对效力、溶解度和脂溶性协同优化的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果表明，优化策略的选择会显著改变所探索化学空间和优化结果，为先导优化中的生成模型评价提供更贴近决策场景的方法。所覆盖任务和性质仍有限，结论能否迁移到更复杂 ADMET 与合成约束需要后续测试。
items.abstract_zh: 多目标优化（MOO）是分子设计的核心，但其对生成化学结果的影响仍缺乏量化。因此，不同 MOO 策略如何影响生成方法中的化学空间探索和性质优化尚不清楚。我们在此引入一个基准框架，用于评估生成化学中的 MOO 策略。我们在先导优化设置中重点考察六种 MOO 方法，包括算术平均和几何平均、非支配排序、切比雪夫标量化、世代距离和二元阈值法。我们在从六个效力数据集衍生的60个骨架上，探索同时优化多种化合物性质（包括效力、溶解度和脂溶性）的多目标任务。我们使用与常见药物化学应用案例或决策场景一致的指标评估这些方法，并考察不同数据集、骨架和预期用途之间的差异。我们发现，MOO 的选择会在不同数据集、骨架和预期使用场景中显著改变优化结果和所探索的化学空间。总体而言，我们的结果为在生成化学工作流中选择和比较 MOO 策略提供了实用、由使用场景驱动的指导。
items.author_line: Paula Torren-Peraire, Nadine Schneider, Raquel Rodríguez-Pérez, Robin A. Fairhurst, Jessica Lanini

items.title: Fluorine-Free Gas Diffusion Media for Polymer Electrolyte Fuel Cells Part I: Silicone-based Microporous Layers
items.abstract_or_text: The widespread use of fluoropolymers in electrochemical energy systems, coupled with increasing environmental, health, and regulatory concerns surrounding per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), is motivating the development of fluorine-free alternatives. Here, silicone-based resins are evaluated as fluorine-free binders for microporous layers (MPLs) and integrated into fully fluorine-free gas diffusion media (GDMs). Using Sylgard 184 silicone elastomer, the binder content was systematically varied, identifying 25 wt.% as the lowest loading that provided sufficient water repellency. At this loading, the influence of binder chemistry was investigated by replacing Sylgard 184 with KR-220L, a methyl silicone rigid resin. Although the resin chemistry strongly affected MPL thickness, porosity, and crack formation, its impact on fuel-cell performance was limited. Fully fluorinefree GDMs were then fabricated by depositing silicone-based MPLs onto carbon fiber substrates hydrophobized via organosilicon electrografting. Replacing a commercial PTFEtreated substrate with the fluorine-free electrografted substrate resulted in only a minor decrease in current density, from 4.2 to 4.0 A cm-2 at 0.3 V under high-humidity conditions; both exceeded the commercial fluorinated reference (3.8 A cm-2). Accelerated stress testing further demonstrated promising durability. Overall, silicone-based materials represent a viable route toward replacing fluorinated components in GDMs.
items.summary_zh: 研究评估硅酮树脂作为聚合物电解质燃料电池微孔层的无氟粘结剂，并以有机硅电接枝疏水化碳纤维基底制备全无氟气体扩散介质。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在高湿度、0.3 V条件下，无氟基底的电流密度为4.0 A cm-2，接近 PTFE 处理基底的4.2 A cm-2，且高于商业含氟参照物的3.8 A cm-2，并有加速应力测试的耐久性支持。该结果聚焦特定材料体系和条件，长期堆栈运行与规模制造仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 电化学能源系统中氟聚合物的广泛使用，以及围绕全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）日益增加的环境、健康和监管担忧，正在推动无氟替代材料的开发。在此，我们评估了硅酮基树脂作为微孔层（MPL）无氟粘结剂的可行性，并将其整合到完全无氟的气体扩散介质（GDM）中。使用 Sylgard 184 硅酮弹性体，系统改变粘结剂含量，确定25 wt.%是能够提供足够拒水性的最低负载量。在这一负载量下，通过以 KR-220L（一种甲基硅酮硬质树脂）替换 Sylgard 184，考察粘结剂化学性质的影响。尽管树脂化学性质强烈影响 MPL 厚度、孔隙率和裂纹形成，其对燃料电池性能的影响有限。随后，通过将硅酮基 MPL 沉积到经有机硅电接枝疏水化处理的碳纤维基底上，制备了完全无氟的 GDM。在高湿度条件下，以无氟电接枝基底替代商业 PTFE 处理基底，仅导致电流密度轻微下降：在0.3 V时从4.2降至4.0 A cm-2；二者均超过商业含氟参照物（3.8 A cm-2）。加速应力测试进一步显示出有前景的耐久性。总体而言，硅酮基材料为替代 GDM 中的含氟组分提供了可行路径。
items.author_line: Irene Sinisgalli, Nicolaas J. M. van Leth, Antoni Forner-Cuenca

items.title: S2F-Agent: Harnessing sequence-to-function models for verifiable genome interpretation
items.abstract_or_text: Sequence-to-function (S2F) models offer a revolutionary paradigm for genotype-phenotype mapping, yet their broader application is bottlenecked by the need for reliable orchestration and interpretation across a fragmented model ecosystem. While general-purpose language models can automate scientific workflows, they are not inherently grounded in the model-specific execution constraints required for robust S2F analysis. Here, we present S2F-Agent, a human-in-the-loop framework designed for the verifiable orchestration of the heterogeneous S2F ecosystems. The framework employs a contract-based harness to bridge model-specific capabilities (Skills) and model-agnostic biological objectives (Playbooks), seamlessly translating free-form biological requests into reliable execution and rigorous downstream interpretation. Evaluated on a benchmark of 54 query cases derived from published S2F workflows, S2F-Agent systematically outperformed general-purpose LLMs, demonstrating superior reliability accuracy in routing, groundedness, and end-to-end task execution success. We further demonstrate the robustness and scalability of S2F-Agent across model adaptation, variant interpretation, genome-scale functional profiling and personal-genome analysis. First, the agent autonomously adapts a genomic foundation model to quantitative chromatin profiles, resolving sequence features associated with primed and active regulatory states. Second, integrating multi-perspective variant effect predictions prioritized 42 high-priority candidate variants among CAD-associated variants (>16,000), and identified tissue-resolved regulatory mechanisms including the hepatic SORT1 axis. Third, genome-scale profiling of multiple traits GWAS atlas variants (>250,000) revealed pervasive context dependence in molecular consequences and regulatory architecture, highlighting the analytical focus toward fine-grained, tissue-specific regulatory variants. Finally, evidence-gated analysis of personal genomes expanded functional hypothesis generation beyond clinically annotated variants to thousands of prioritized candidates per individual while imposing explicit evidence-dependent boundaries on clinical claims. Collectively, these results establish S2F-Agent as a general framework for converting heterogeneous sequence-to-function capabilities into verifiable, scalable, and evidence-aware genomic analyses. By bridging the chasm between LLMs, specialized S2F ecosystems and rigorous genomic science, this framework democratizes the S2F paradigm for unlocking the full potential of these advanced models in real-world discoveries.
items.summary_zh: S2F-Agent 以“Skills—Playbooks”及合同式执行框架，将自然语言生物学需求转化为可验证的 sequence-to-function 分析；其在54个已发表工作流查询组成的基准中优于通用 LLM。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作面向基因组基础模型的可靠编排，展示了染色质模型适配、CAD 变异优先排序及超过25万 GWAS 图谱变异的分析等案例。临床相关结果仍属功能假设生成，且框架的可靠性依赖于模型能力描述、工作流和证据规则的完整性。
items.abstract_zh: 序列到功能（S2F）模型为基因型—表型映射提供了一种革命性范式，但其更广泛的应用受到以下需求的限制：必须在碎片化的模型生态系统中进行可靠的编排和解释。尽管通用语言模型可以自动化科学工作流，但它们并非天然扎根于稳健 S2F 分析所需的模型特异执行约束。在此，我们提出 S2F-Agent：一个人在回路框架，旨在对异质性 S2F 生态系统进行可验证的编排。该框架采用基于合同的 harness，以桥接模型特异能力（Skills）与模型无关的生物学目标（Playbooks），将自由形式的生物学请求无缝转换为可靠执行和严格的下游解释。在由已发表 S2F 工作流衍生的54个查询案例组成的基准上评估时，S2F-Agent 在路由、扎根性和端到端任务执行成功率方面系统优于通用 LLM，表现出更高的可靠性准确度。我们还展示了 S2F-Agent 在模型适配、变异解释、全基因组尺度功能图谱和个人基因组分析中的稳健性与可扩展性。首先，该智能体自主将一个基因组基础模型适配到定量染色质图谱，解析了与预激和活跃调控状态相关的序列特征。第二，整合多视角变异效应预测后，它在 CAD 相关变异（超过16,000个）中优先筛出42个高优先级候选变异，并识别出包括肝脏 SORT1 轴在内的组织分辨调控机制。第三，对多个性状 GWAS 图谱变异（超过250,000个）的全基因组尺度分析揭示了分子后果和调控架构中普遍存在的情境依赖性，突出了分析应聚焦于精细的、组织特异性调控变异。最后，对个人基因组的证据约束分析，将功能假设生成扩展到临床注释变异以外，每名个体可得到数千个优先候选，同时对临床主张施加明确的、依赖证据的限制。总体而言，这些结果确立了 S2F-Agent 作为通用框架，可将异质性 sequence-to-function 能力转化为可验证、可扩展且具备证据意识的基因组分析。通过弥合 LLM、专门的 S2F 生态系统与严谨基因组科学之间的鸿沟，该框架使 S2F 范式得以普及，从而释放这些先进模型在现实发现中的全部潜力。
items.author_line: Li, J., Qin, T., Li, J. G., Bao, Z.

review.note: 本次从48项候选中选出7项，优先保留具有明确数据规模、独立基准或实验验证的化学与生命科学交叉工作。
